capabilities: Pull tasks, events, routines and habits into the vault as plain markdown notes
Drag task cards onto morning or afternoon lanes for each day of the week
Sync task completion and edits back to Todoist and ClickUp behind opt-in switches
Turn starred or flagged email into tasks via IMAP presets
Write weekly priorities and daily highlights in a per-week note
extras: Part of the ICOR for Life suite and not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README states it is beta with rough edges, and Outlook setup is documented in a step-by-step guide in docs/. Two-way write-back to sources is off by default and the plugin never deletes anything at a source.
motivation: The author found that planning fails at the gathering step, not the deciding step: once everything is visible on one surface, the choice becomes easy.
problem: Planning a week means checking several task apps, mailboxes and calendars before deciding anything, which spends the energy needed for the actual choices.

relations.evidence: With a key configured it talks to Todoist, ClickUp, your own IMAP host, the iCal addresses you paste
Tasks from a connected source are a mirror of that source.

requires.name: Todoist, ClickUp, an IMAP mail host, or an iCal feed
Outlook/Microsoft 365 sign-in for Outlook calendar and mail
API keys or app passwords per connected source

summary: Weekly planner board that pulls tasks from Todoist, ClickUp, starred email and iCal calendars into markdown notes and schedules them across morning and afternoon lanes.
